title: Helmets Returned
story: {n} knights get their helmets back at random.

phases.ask: Expected number of knights who get their own helmet?

hints: Indicator I_i: P(I_i = 1) = 1/n. Then Cov(I_i, I_j)?

title: The Six Runes
story: Each chest holds one of {k} runes, equally likely. You open chests until you own all {k}.
hints: After i different runes, the wait for a new one is geometric with p = (k − i)/k.
solution: Σ k/(k − i) = k·H_k ≈ 14.7 for k = 6.

title: Feast Days
story: {n} villagers have independent uniform birthdays (365 days).
hints: Indicator for each day: is it somebody's birthday?
pattern: count distinct values via indicators on the values

title: Empty Barrels
story: {n} apples are tossed into {n} barrels, each barrel equally likely.

title: Runs of Fortune
story: A fair coin is flipped {n} times. A run is a maximal block of equal outcomes.
hints: A new run starts at flip i > 1 exactly when flip i ≠ flip i−1.

title: Partner Draw
story: {m} men and {m} women are randomly split into {m} pairs.
hints: Indicator per man: P(his partner is a woman) = ?

title: Ones and Twos
story: A die is rolled {n} times; X = number of 1s, Y = number of 2s.
hints: Write X = ΣI_i and Y = ΣJ_i; only same-roll pairs matter.

title: The Carp Pond
story: A pond has {N} fish, {K} of them carp. You catch {n}.
hints: Hypergeometric variance = binomial variance × the finite-population correction.

title: The Miner's Three Doors
story: A trapped miner picks one of three doors at random each time (he forgets). Door 1 loops back after {a} days, door 2 after {b} days, door 3 leads out in {c} days.
hints: Condition on the first door: E = ⅓(a + E) + ⅓(b + E) + ⅓c.

title: The Tower Lift
story: The number of people entering the tower lift is Poisson({lam}). Each picks one of {N} floors at random.

phases.ask: Expected number of floors where the lift stops?

hints: Thinning: arrivals for each floor are Poisson(λ/N).

title: Accident Ledger
story: A mine averages {m} accidents a week; each injures {w} miners on average (independently of the count).

title: The Generating Rune
hints: Recognise the MGF. Which distribution has this form?

title: Both Faces
story: A coin (heads probability {p}) is flipped until both heads and tails have appeared.
hints: Condition on the first flip, then wait for the other face (geometric).
